source.title: Cost-effectiveness of pramipexole augmentation for acute phase and maintenance therapy of treatment-resistant depression compared to placebo augmentation: economic evaluation of the PAX-D randomised controlled trial.

scope: Exact 13-page original economic evaluation only, including tables and figures; verify PAX-D parent relation, actual TRD eligibility, economic population versus parent trial, randomized/analyzed/imputed/complete-case Ns, acute/maintenance horizons, health-system/societal perspectives, currency and price year, utilities/QALYs, costs, incremental differences, uncertainty, bootstrap/cost-effectiveness probability/WTP thresholds and sensitivity analyses. Economic outcomes are not new independent clinical efficacy or prescribing/access guidance.
sourcePolicy: Closed exact Reed main PDF and index. No source acquisition. Existing old main PDF has different bytes, companion DOCX availability metadata only; old content not borrowed or accepted, prior records/held states immutable. Companion content and external protocol/SAP/current registry/corrections remain not_checked unless separately scoped.
identity: Reuse B-R0112 report/B-R0112-F01 and aliases, prior partial review/result identities as matched. Fresh source bytes require own audit. Prospectively examine nested PAX-D family before candidate, no new independent trial/patient counts.
schema: SCHEMA.json with exact locators plus pinned 15Q/67 input fields
downstream: Private unapplied D05 and actual TRD/C09 context if verified; economic context separate from benefit grade/clinical efficacy; zero canonical or public changes
verification: All 13 pages and material tables/figures, source/index/GP hashes, exact independent root audit, meaningful numeric/inference guards, fullfield/science/human/release false
ownership: Same lane1 runner and phase2 packet only; PR8 immutable, no subagents, no outbound messaging or release actions
